routine.heading: One letter, four little steps
routine.intro: Every letter follows the same routine, so your child always knows what comes next.

steps.title: Trace it
steps.body: Follow the arrows to trace the uppercase and lowercase letter, then try it on your own.

steps.title: Say it
steps.body: Look at the picture word and say the letter’s sound out loud together.

steps.title: Find it
steps.body: Hunt for the letter hiding in a busy picture and circle every one.

steps.title: Color it
steps.body: Finish the page by coloring the picture. A small win to end on.

items.name: Letter recognition
items.body: Spotting each letter in uppercase and lowercase, even inside a busy picture.

items.name: Letter sounds
items.body: Linking every letter to a familiar picture word and its first sound.

items.name: Pencil control
items.body: Tracing straight lines, curves and loops with the correct starting point.

items.name: Focus and finishing
items.body: Short, complete pages that build the habit of finishing a task.

faq.a: Straight away. The PDF is emailed to you right after checkout, including when you order the printed book.

faq.q: What paper and printer do I need?
faq.a: Any home printer and regular letter or A4 paper. Thicker paper holds up better to crayons and markers.

faq.q: Is it right for my child?
faq.a: Alphabet Adventures is made for ages 3 to 6. Younger learners can focus on tracing and coloring; older ones can say each sound and find every letter.

faq.q: How does shipping work for the printed book?
faq.a: Enter your address at checkout. You’ll get the PDF by email while the book is on its way.
